top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
Protect each resident from the wrongful use of the resident's belongings or money.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for a resident to maintain and/or improve range of motion (ROM), limited ROM and/or mobility, unless a decline is for a medical reason.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies
